what.text: This page follows refugees from Grenada in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 117 Grenadian refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 67.5% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Grenada: an interstate armed conflict with the United States of America in 1983.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2006 to 2015, come long after it.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1988 at 9 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 344, at the end of 2010.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
